Maharashtra Prepares for Uniform Civil Code, Committee Announcement Expected

Maharashtra is reportedly preparing to implement a Uniform Civil Code (UCC), with an announcement regarding a dedicated committee anticipated next week. Chief Minister Eknath Shinde has indicated progress on the matter. This move follows discussions and preparations in other states regarding the UCC.
